name: Beechcraft Bonanza V35 (V-tail)
summary: Postwar high-performance four-to-six-seat retractable single famous for its butterfly V-tail, built from 1947 to 1982.

wings: Low, tapered wing with marked dihedral
engines: Single flat-six in a long, smooth cowl
fuselage: Sleek four-to-six-seat cabin with a single right-side door
tail: Butterfly V-tail: two surfaces in a V with no separate vertical fin

tellTales: V-shaped tail with no vertical fin
Sleek low-wing single with retractable gear
Single cabin door on the right side

confusedWith.howToTell: The A36/F33 has a conventional fin and horizontal tail; the V35 has a V-tail.
The Comanche has a conventional swept fin with stabilator; the V35 has no fin, just a V-tail.
The Mooney has a conventional tail whose fin appears swept forward; the V35 has a V-tail.
The V35 has a V-tail; the Viking has a single tall vertical fin and a normal horizontal tail.
The V35 has a V-tail; the Cruisemaster has three vertical fins on a conventional tail.
The V-tail Bonanza is obvious from its V-tail; the Meyers 200 has a conventional fin and horizontal tail.
